raw_timetable_audit.result: PASS: each departure, arrival and endpoint matches original GTFS

evidence.direct_fact: TransLink awarded Nova Bus a CAD 16 million contract for 15 battery-electric buses.
evidence.inference: 16000000 / 15 = 1066666.6667 CAD per bus, as a historical batch-contract average.
evidence.limitations: Not a present-day marginal quote; contract inclusions are not fully itemized. Do not re-label as a verified bare-vehicle price or apply it to another model. Values remain nominal 2021 CAD.

evidence.direct_fact: The first of the 15 new buses is identified as Nova LFSe+. The announcement states 150 km per charge and approximately five minutes for an on-route top-up.
evidence.limitations: The range is not a universal winter/full-load guarantee. A five-minute top-up is not a full recharge. Exact battery configuration is not established by the model name.

evidence.direct_fact: Route 100 was then the only route with overhead charging infrastructure at its ends and on-route charging capability.
evidence.consequence: Do not invent en-route chargers for routes 229, 231 or 236.

limits: No physical energy/SOC, bay-transfer, passenger-load or depot certification.
